svg.text: Same OpenRocket model, same rocket · the only difference between the blue and violet curves is when the chute opens
Simulation overshot the real flight by 146 m · this splits that gap into its two causes

svg.text: OpenRocket — chute at the 14 s factory delay
OpenRocket — chute forced open at 8.3 s
Violet curve integrated forward from Simulation 2’s own recorded state at 8.3 s (alt 693 m, climbing 24.2 m/s), using the chute Cd·A of 0.493 m² calibrated from that same run’s steady descent.
Canopy inflation modelled over 0.3 s; apogee spans 698–707 m across a 0–0.8 s inflation range, so the −20 m figure is good to a few metres.
